hero.eyebrow: For the moments you wish were easier
hero.heading: The little things
hero.copy: That daily hassle you barely notice anymore. The routine you'd love to simplify. We believe a thoughtful find can make everyday moments feel a little lighter—and knowing if it's right for you should be simple.
hero.concept_alt: Illustrative scene of a desk organizer, smartphone and an open parcel.

principles.label: What matters to HiParcelo
principles.useful_copy: Ideas that begin with familiar, everyday frustrations.
principles.clarity_copy: A closer look is part of making a choice that feels right.
principles.help_copy: A clear place to ask when you want to know more.

discovery.heading: Imagine the easier moment.
discovery.copy: You know the feeling: you spot an idea and immediately picture where it could fit into your life. We love that moment. We also believe the practical details should make just as much sense as the idea itself.
discovery.concept_alt: Illustrative scene of a hand placing a pen in a sage-green organizer on a desk.
discovery.life_copy: A small frustration. A task that takes more effort than it should. A moment you'd like to improve.
discovery.detail_copy: A thoughtful idea can make you look at your everyday routine in a whole new way.
discovery.choice_title: And the details make it yours.
discovery.choice_copy: The fit, the intended use and the full picture help you choose without feeling rushed.
discovery.price_details: Find the available options, full costs and delivery information on the product page.

about.heading: Less noise. Better discoveries.
about.copy: There are plenty of things you could buy. We're interested in the ones worth considering. HiParcelo is taking a focused approach to practical finds: understand the problem, appreciate the possibility, and make the details easy to see before deciding.

help.label: Know what to expect and how to get help
help.delivery_copy: Delivery details, when an offer is ready.
help.contact_copy: We're here to hear what's on your mind.

faq.heading: Good questions. Clear answers.
faq.products_question: What kind of things will HiParcelo feature?
faq.products_answer: We're building HiParcelo around practical ideas for familiar everyday frustrations. Our first focused offer is still being prepared; no products are available to order yet.
faq.delivery_question: Will I know when and where you deliver?
faq.delivery_answer: When ordering opens, each offer will show its supported destinations, processing and delivery estimate, relevant costs and customs information before checkout. We won't turn an unverified transit claim into a delivery promise.
faq.returns_answer: The applicable cancellation and return rights, conditions, costs and instructions will be explained for the actual product and destination before purchases begin.
faq.help_question: Can I talk to someone before choosing?
faq.help_answer: Yes. Reach HiParcelo through the contact page or support email for questions about our brand and the information currently available. Our operating support hours will be confirmed before orders open.

closing.heading: Discovering something useful should feel good.
closing.copy: And understanding it should feel just as easy. Get to know the thinking behind HiParcelo.

form.intro: Sometimes it's one detail that makes all the difference. Tell us what you'd like to know about HiParcelo, and we'll be clear about what we can answer.

tracking.heading: Follow the parcel. Keep the clarity.
tracking.intro: Your order's own status page is the place for confirmed updates.
tracking.step_one_copy: Choose the order-status link in the confirmation sent when your order was placed.
tracking.step_two_copy: Tracking appears once a shipment has been created. A label alone does not mean the parcel is moving.
tracking.step_three_copy: Use our contact page and include your order number. Never share your password or payment details.
tracking.account_copy: If your order is linked to a customer account, sign in to see it.
tracking.no_lookup: We do not show order information from an order number alone. Use your secure order-status link or contact us for help.
tracking.prelaunch: No live tracking service is connected to this preview. Shipment events will come from authenticated order data; no example events are presented as real.

product.fit_copy: Read the dimensions, materials, compatibility and care details for the actual product. Ask us if anything is unclear.

product.preview_title: Good things can begin with one little idea.
product.preview_copy: We're starting with one focused find, chosen around a familiar everyday need. When it's ready, we'll share the real product details and what to expect—so the excitement doesn't come with unnecessary guesswork.
product.preview_problem: It begins with a familiar feeling
product.preview_problem_copy: The moment you think: there must be a simpler way to do this. That's the kind of question we want to start with.
product.preview_proof_copy: A good first impression is just the beginning. Photos, intended use, dimensions and limitations matter too.
product.preview_fit_copy: Think about your space, your routine and what matters to you. The right details make that picture clearer.
product.preview_service_copy: When we're ready to sell, the price, destination, delivery and return details will be available alongside the offer.

faq.heading: Good questions. Clearer answers.
faq.intro: The things worth knowing when you're getting to know a new brand.
faq.brand_a: HiParcelo is being shaped around familiar everyday problems and thoughtful possibilities. We're preparing one focused first offer.
faq.order_a: Not just yet. We're taking time to prepare our first offer and the details that go with it. You'll know when it's available.
faq.products_q: Is the item in your imagery for sale?
faq.products_a: Not yet. Our current images illustrate the brand direction. We'll show actual product information when the first offer is ready.
faq.delivery_q: Where do you deliver and how long will it take?
faq.delivery_a: We're confirming the first destination and delivery route. Before any purchase is possible, we'll show the actual processing and delivery estimates, available locations and applicable charges.
faq.returns_a: Before orders open, we'll explain the applicable cancellation rights, return steps, costs and refund process clearly on the relevant pages.
faq.tracking_q: How can I track an order?
faq.tracking_a: Once orders are available, the secure order-status link in your confirmation email will show available tracking information. We won't invent delivery events.
faq.support_a: You can use the Contact page or write to hiparcelo@gmail.com. If it's about an order, include the order reference when possible.
faq.health_a: Our general guides aren't medical advice. Products involving health or safety claims require their own specific review before sale.
faq.feedback_a: When there's genuine customer feedback, we can show it honestly. We don't invent reviews, customer counts or ratings.

hi_edit.hero_copy: You know that little annoyance you've learned to live with? The clutter. The extra step. The small inconvenience. We love the moment a clever idea makes you think: why didn't I do this sooner?
hi_edit.hero_footnote: A little curiosity. A lot of possibility.
hi_edit.hero_bottom: GOOD IDEAS AREN'T ALWAYS BIG ONES
hi_edit.feeling_copy: Not a grand transformation. Just those ordinary moments when a little less clutter, a little less effort or a little more comfort would feel surprisingly good.
hi_edit.feeling_space_copy: The everyday spaces that could do with a touch more thought.
hi_edit.feeling_effort_copy: The extra step you've repeated so often you barely notice it.
hi_edit.feeling_comfort_copy: A routine you wish felt just a bit more comfortable.
hi_edit.method_copy: That spark of discovery is wonderful. But the right choice is the one that still makes sense once you know the details. Here's the standard we're building our first offer around.
hi_edit.method_one_a: Start with the actual everyday frustration. An interesting demonstration isn't enough on its own; the intended purpose should be easy to recognize and explain.
hi_edit.method_two_q: Can I see what it really does?
hi_edit.method_two_a: When an item launches, its real photography, intended use, specifications, included items and limitations should explain the offer without asking you to guess.
hi_edit.method_three_a: Dimensions, compatibility, materials and care belong alongside the exciting part. That's how you can picture the item in your space or routine.
hi_edit.method_four_a: Before checkout opens, we intend to make the actual total cost, delivery eligibility, estimated timeline, applicable return rights and support route clear for that offer.
hi_edit.method_note: The first offer is being prepared. This is the approach we're building toward, not a claim that product or delivery testing is already complete.
hi_edit.manifesto_head_a: The best find isn't the one everyone wants.
hi_edit.manifesto_head_b: It's the one that makes sense to you.
hi_edit.manifesto_copy: We'd rather make it easier to understand a good idea than pressure you to decide quickly. Recognizing the need comes first. The details make the decision yours.
hi_edit.manifesto_link: More about our point of view
hi_edit.journal_copy: A few small things worth knowing before anything finds its way into your life. No jargon. No sales pitch. Just genuinely useful questions.
hi_edit.journal_one: Five things to know before you choose.
hi_edit.journal_one_copy: From what's included to the full cost and what happens after an order.
hi_edit.journal_two: When the idea meets your real life.
hi_edit.journal_two_copy: A gentle reminder to check size, space and compatibility.
hi_edit.journal_three: A little care goes a long way.
hi_edit.journal_three_copy: Get more from the things you choose by understanding their intended use.
hi_edit.first_head_a: Not a shelf full of things.
hi_edit.first_copy: We're preparing our first focused find. The idea is simple: start with a recognizable everyday need and build a clear, useful offer around it. We won't pretend the details are ready before they are.

hi_edit.last_kicker: OUR DOOR IS OPEN TO QUESTIONS
hi_edit.last_copy: Something you'd love to make easier? Wondering how HiParcelo works? We'd like to hear it.
hi_edit.footer_statement: The ordinary moments deserve a little more thought.
hi_edit.footer_status: Our first offer is in preparation. Ordering is not currently available.
hi_edit.about_quote: We're not here to tell you that you need more things. We're interested in what makes the things you choose worth having.
hi_edit.rail_title: There's always room for a question.
hi_edit.rail_copy: If a detail isn't clear, we'd rather you ask than assume. Reach us through the contact page.
hi_edit.contact_copy: Maybe it's an everyday frustration you've been thinking about. Maybe it's a question about how HiParcelo works. Either way, we'd love to hear what's on your mind.

hi_v2.signals_head: More than a good first impression.
hi_v2.signals_head_em: A reason to choose with confidence.
hi_v2.signals_intro: A thoughtful experience begins before there's a product to add to your cart. Here's the thinking we want every future find to stand up to.
hi_v2.signals_a_copy: An interesting demonstration is not enough. A useful discovery begins with an everyday problem worth solving.
hi_v2.signals_b_copy: Specifications, intended use and honest limitations should help you decide for yourself.
hi_v2.signals_c_copy: Price, supported destinations, delivery estimates and help channels must make sense before we accept orders.
hi_v2.lens_intro: The most useful discoveries start with something you've already noticed. Pick the everyday feeling that sounds most familiar.
hi_v2.lens_a: A space that doesn't quite work.
hi_v2.lens_a_copy: The drawer, counter or corner that needs room to breathe. Before choosing anything new, check dimensions, compatibility and the actual space available.
hi_v2.lens_b: A task with one step too many.
hi_v2.lens_b_copy: The workaround that has become part of your day. Know what's included, its intended use and the full cost before deciding.
hi_v2.lens_c: A routine that could feel better.
hi_v2.lens_c_copy: Sometimes a small improvement to a repeated moment matters most. Look closely at intended use, care and limitations.
hi_v2.lens_note: These are situations we're exploring, not products currently available for purchase.
hi_v2.clarity_intro: Discovery can be exciting. The essential information that follows should feel straightforward, specific and easy to find.
hi_v2.clarity_delivery_copy: When an offer launches, supported countries, estimated timelines and relevant conditions should be visible before ordering.
hi_v2.clarity_returns_copy: Read how returns are handled and what rights or conditions apply, including product-specific exceptions.
hi_v2.clarity_support_copy: There should be a clear place to ask questions instead of relying on assumptions.
hi_v2.clarity_tracking_copy: When orders begin, tracking should be based on authentic fulfillment information, not invented events.
hi_v2.clarity_note: HiParcelo is not accepting orders yet. Product availability, served countries and delivery times are not yet confirmed.

hp27.hero_lede: A new perspective on the little problems we all know. We explore useful ideas, reveal the important details and make discovery feel exciting again.
hp27.hero_fine: No endless catalogue. Just a different way to discover.
hp27.hero_scene_alt: An abstract luminous futuristic parcel symbol surrounded by glowing orbits. Brand concept artwork; not a product.
hp27.hero_bottom: CURIOUS BY DESIGN / CLEAR BY INTENTION
hp27.explore_kicker: THE WORLD THROUGH A DIFFERENT LENS
hp27.explore_intro: Start with a familiar frustration. Every perspective leads to a practical question, not a product you have to buy.
hp27.space_tab_sub: Less clutter. More room to breathe.
hp27.comfort_tab_sub: A little more ease, every day.
hp27.space_copy: A more useful setup starts with understanding what fits, what doesn't, and what actually needs to change.
hp27.time_copy: A clever idea is only useful when the purpose, included items and total cost genuinely make sense.
hp27.comfort_copy: Consider intended use, limitations and care before trusting an exciting demonstration.
hp27.explore_foot: Exploration concepts only. Our first offer is in preparation. No products are available to order here.
hp27.system_kicker: THE DIFFERENCE IS IN THE DETAILS
hp27.system_copy: A striking visual is a beginning, not a reason to buy. We're preparing our first release around a clearer standard.
hp27.system_step1_copy: Identify a recognizable everyday frustration before proposing a solution.
hp27.system_step2_copy: Check intended use, fit, materials, limitations and available supplier evidence.
hp27.system_step3_copy: Explain what's included, total price, supported destinations and delivery conditions before checkout.
hp27.system_step4_copy: Make real order updates, questions, return routes and support easy to find.
hp27.system_note: This is our launch standard, not a claim that product, shipping or supplier verification is complete.
hp27.story_intro: No homepage catalogue. Instead, useful stories and questions that help you evaluate future discoveries with confidence.
hp27.story_c: MAKE THE MOST OF WHAT YOU CHOOSE.
hp27.story_foot: ORIGINAL EDITORIAL CONCEPTS / NOT CUSTOMER REVIEWS OR SOCIAL POSTS
